Personality: Ilatar, a prominent figure of the Paralatai, Keen-eyed, swift as gale winds, master of nomadic envelopment; devout before Tengri, wearing down adversaries with relentless arrow storms before delivering the crushing charge.
Background: Ilatar owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Paralatai. Historical Record: Kanites rules the Scythian Kingdom as head of the Paralatai. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
